props.colorScheme: Color scheme: "default" or the name of any --color-<name>-50 … 950 palette. Unset, it inherits from the parent element.
props.portalColorScheme: Color scheme for the content. Content renders in a portal, so it can't inherit a scheme from the trigger's parents.
props.variant: Visual style. Colors come from the color scheme.
props.disabled: Prevents interaction and dims the component.
props.label: Text shown next to the control, rendered with Label. Without it, pass aria-label.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible name, for when there is no visible label.
props.defaultOpen: Open state on first render, when uncontrolled.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new open state when it changes.
props.modal: When true, blocks interaction with the rest of the page while open.
props.openDelay: Milliseconds before it opens on hover.
props.closeDelay: Milliseconds before it closes after the pointer leaves.

Accordion.description: Vertically stacked headings that each reveal a section of content.

props.type: "single" opens one item at a time; "multiple" allows several.
props.collapsible: With type "single", lets the open item be closed again.

story.answer1: Yes. It follows the WAI-ARIA pattern.

cssVariables.--accordion-padding-y: Vertical padding of triggers and content

AlertDialog.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user and asks them to confirm an action. AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel render Button.

AspectRatio.description: Keeps its child at a set width-to-height ratio. Unstyled.

Avatar.description: An image of a person, with a fallback (usually initials) while it loads or if it fails.

Button.description: Triggers an action. Style with variant, color with colorScheme.

props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a link) with button styles instead of a <button>.

Checkbox.description: A control that toggles between checked and unchecked, with an optional indeterminate state.

props.icon: Icon shown when checked. Defaults to Radix CheckIcon.
props.indeterminateIcon: Icon shown when checked is "indeterminate". Defaults to Radix MinusIcon.

cssVariables.--checkbox-gap: Space between the box and its label

Code.description: Inline code, such as a command or a function name. Sizes are relative to the surrounding text.

props.copyable: Show a button that copies the code.
props.copyLabel: Accessible name of the copy button.
props.copiedLabel: Accessible name of the copy button after copying.

cssVariables.copy-gap: Space between the code and its copy button

CodeBlock.description: A block of preformatted code with a copy button. Long lines scroll horizontally.

props.copyable: Show a button that copies the code.
props.copyLabel: Accessible name of the copy button.
props.copiedLabel: Accessible name of the copy button after copying.

Collapsible.description: A section that expands and collapses. Unstyled: style the trigger and content yourself. Content animates its height.

story.content: Hidden details, revealed with a height animation.

ContextMenu.description: A menu that opens on right-click (or long-press) over its trigger area.

Dialog.description: A modal window over the page. DialogContent includes a close button unless showClose is false.

story.title: Edit profile
story.description: Changes are saved when you click Save.

cssVariables.--dialog-gap: Space between header, body and footer

DropdownMenu.description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button.

HoverCard.description: A preview card that appears when a pointer hovers over a link.

Label.description: Text that names a form control. Clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

props.htmlFor: id of the control this label names.

Menubar.description: A horizontal bar of menus, like an application's File and Edit menus.

NavigationMenu.description: Site navigation links, with optional panels that open below the list.

Popover.description: Floating content anchored to a trigger, opened by clicking it.

Progress.description: Shows how far a task has progressed.

props.value: Current progress, from 0 to max. Leave unset when the amount is unknown.

Radio.description: A set of options where only one can be selected. RadioGroup passes size and icon to its Radios.

props.size: Size of every Radio in the group.
props.icon: Default checked icon for every Radio in the group. Radio's own icon prop overrides it.

cssVariables.--radio-gap: Space between the circle and its label
cssVariables.--radio-group-gap: Space between radios in a group

ScrollArea.description: A scrollable area with custom, themeable scrollbars.

Select.description: Picks one value from a list. The trigger matches TextInput's variants and sizes.

cssVariables.--select-gap: Space between the value and the chevron

Separator.description: A line that separates content, horizontally or vertically.

props.decorative: Purely visual: hidden from screen readers. Set false when it separates meaningful sections.

Slider.description: Picks a value, or a range, by dragging along a track. Renders one thumb per value.

props.aria-label: Accessible name, applied to every thumb.

Switch.description: A control that turns a setting on or off.

cssVariables.--switch-gap: Space between the switch and its label

Tabs.description: Sections of content shown one at a time, chosen from a row of tabs.

cssVariables.--tabs-gap: Space between the tab list and content

TextInput.description: A single-line text field for text, email, search or URL input.

props.type: Input type. Only text, email, search and url are allowed; anything else falls back to text.
props.prependElement: Shown before the input, usually an icon.
props.appendElement: Shown after the input, usually an icon.

Toast.description: A short, temporary message. Place a ToastProvider and ToastViewport once in the app. ToastAction renders Button.

Toggle.description: A button that stays pressed or unpressed.

ToggleGroup.description: A set of toggles where one or several can be pressed. variant and size apply to every item.

props.type: "single" allows one pressed item; "multiple" allows several.

Toolbar.description: A row of buttons, toggles and links. Buttons use the Toggle styles.

props.size: Size of buttons and toggles in the toolbar.

Tooltip.description: A short label that appears on hover or focus. Wrap the app (or a section) in TooltipProvider once.

props.side: Preferred side of the trigger to show on.
props.showArrow: Show the arrow pointing at the trigger.

Typography.description: Styled text. Renders a <span> by default; use asChild to style another element such as a heading or paragraph.

props.font: Font family: Roboto (sans), Roboto Serif (serif) or Roboto Mono (mono).
props.size: Font size and line height, from xxs to xxl.
props.asChild:
Render the child element (e.g. an

or

) with typography styles instead of a .

story.children: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

cssVariables.intro: Override any of these in your CSS, globally or for a section, e.g. :root { --button-radius: 9999px; }. Defaults that use a scheme shade follow the component's color scheme.

suffixes.checked-bg-hover: Background color on hover when checked
suffixes.text-transform: Text case, e.g. uppercase or none
suffixes.focus-offset: Gap between the component and its focus ring
suffixes.indicator-scale: Scale of the check or dot icon
suffixes.item-highlight-bg: Item background when highlighted by pointer or keyboard
suffixes.item-hover-bg: Item background on hover or when open

parts.menu-content: Menu (shared with DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Menubar and Select)
parts.toggle: Toggle (shared with Toggle, ToggleGroup and Toolbar)
